sections.title: X-ray I
sections.description: An introduction to the theory and practice of small molecule structure determination by X-ray crystallography. Topics discussed include point group and space group symmetry, structure factor theory, data collection methodology and a survey of solution methods. The course will include case studies of real-world structure determinations and interpreting X-ray structures.
